coverage.completeMeans: All 74 provided original images visually read; does not mean every current source position is covered or morphology has been adjudicated.

reproduction: Run compare-current-accordance.cjs with the pinned draft commit, the exact input ledger hashes and an original image index matching inputs[0].imageIndexSha256; full per-observation results are reproducible and not duplicated in this summary.
